title: Alkylating chemotherapy: naming and classes (R-10002)
description: Alkylating chemotherapy are drugs whose mechanism of action is: damage cancer-cell DNA, preventing replication. This class has no single naming suffix. Example drugs include cyclophosphamide, cisplatin, temozolomide.

spec.educational: Educational reference only; not medical advice. No dosage information is stored in this database.
